reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands as a primitive P-1, Z=1 cell (68.02205 A^3) with seven fully occupied atoms and exact Li1Ni2O4 composition; primitive/Niggli reduction does not reveal a supercell or alternate setting. About 40 resolved reflections are consistently indexed by the triclinic metric (2theta MAE about 0.0025-0.003 degrees, with no important unindexed line), while a monoclinic metric cannot reproduce the observed splittings. Crucially, the instantiated atomic model was refined against integrated intensities and the full profile, not positions alone: 14 independent coordinate starts converged to the same oxygen coordinates, and the final whole-profile fit has RMSE 0.148 intensity units (approximately 5.3% unweighted profile residual) versus approximately 0.106 noise and a 42-independent-intensity lower-bound RMSE of about 0.128. The small excess and weak 19.06-degree mismatch do not support a distinct realization. Li/Ni/vacancy orderings on the four cation inversion centers are either origin-equivalent to the submitted ordering after oxygen relabeling or grossly inferior in intensity fit. Periodic shells show octahedral Li-O (2.129-2.172 A) and Ni-O (1.866-2.008 A) coordination without overlaps; bond-valence analysis gives Li(+1), Ni(+4), Ni(+3), and O(-2), exactly charge balanced. Thus an explicit ordered realization has convergent coordinate-sensitive diffraction support and no concrete incompatible branch survives.
